name: Sudden change in financial behaviour and lifestyle
description: Customer shifts from stable spending to minimal discretionary spend, repeated cash withdrawals, closing of long-standing products or giving away assets.
fp: May have innocent explanations; assess in context of customer profile and other indicators.

sources.text: FATF, Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Guidance (2019)
FATF, Ethnically or Racially Motivated Terrorism Financing (2021)

links.name: Sudden change in financial behaviour and lifestyle
